text: Morning! Is this the Dunkin drive-thru assistant?
translation: Morning! Is this the Dunkin drive-thru assistant?

text: Absolutely! I'm your Dunkin crew assistant. Ready for your first sip?
translation: Absolutely! I'm your Dunkin crew assistant. Ready for your first sip?

text: Sí, necesito dos Caramel Craze lattes medianos. Agregue un toque de sabor extra al primero, por favor.
translation: Yes, I need two medium Caramel Craze lattes. Add an extra flavor swirl to the first one, please.

text: ¡Perfecto! Dos Caramel Craze Lattes medianos, con un toque de sabor extra en el primero. ¿Algo más?
translation: Perfect! Two medium Caramel Craze Lattes, with an extra flavor swirl on the first. Anything else?

text: 我想要一杯大杯的红糖奶油冷萃咖啡，谢谢。
translation: I'd like a large Brown Sugar Cream Cold Brew, thanks.

text: 好的，已经为您添加一杯大杯红糖奶油冷萃咖啡。要不要加一份风味糖浆？
translation: Sure, added one large Brown Sugar Cream Cold Brew. Would you like a flavor swirl added too?

text: Yes, add a flavor swirl to that too.
translation: Yes, add a flavor swirl to that too.

text: Got it — a flavor swirl added to the Cold Brew as well. Anything else?
translation: Got it — a flavor swirl added to the Cold Brew as well. Anything else?

text: I'll also take a large Strawberry Dragonfruit Refresher with an extra shot of espresso.
translation: I'll also take a large Strawberry Dragonfruit Refresher with an extra shot of espresso.

text: You got it! Large Strawberry Dragonfruit Refresher with an extra espresso shot added. Anything from the bakery case?
translation: You got it! Large Strawberry Dragonfruit Refresher with an extra espresso shot added. Anything from the bakery case?

text: Ajoutez 3 beignets glacés et deux sandwichs bacon, œuf et fromage sur croissant, s'il vous plaît.
translation: Add 3 glazed donuts and two bacon egg and cheese croissant sandwiches, please.

text: Parfait, 3 beignets glacés et deux Bacon Egg & Cheese sur croissant ajoutés. Voulez-vous le récapitulatif de la commande ?
translation: Perfect, 3 glazed donuts and two Bacon Egg & Cheese on Croissant added. Would you like the order summary?

text: You have 2 Medium Caramel Craze Lattes (one with a flavor swirl), 1 Large Brown Sugar Cream Cold Brew with a flavor swirl, 1 Large Strawberry Dragonfruit Refresher with an extra espresso shot, 3 Glazed Donuts, and 2 Bacon Egg & Cheese on Croissant. Your total is $39.43 with tax.
translation: You have 2 Medium Caramel Craze Lattes (one with a flavor swirl), 1 Large Brown Sugar Cream Cold Brew with a flavor swirl, 1 Large Strawberry Dragonfruit Refresher with an extra espresso shot, 3 Glazed Donuts, and 2 Bacon Egg & Cheese on Croissant. Your total is $39.43 with tax.

text: Thanks for rolling with Dunkin today! Swing to the next window and we'll have your order ready.
translation: Thanks for rolling with Dunkin today! Swing to the next window and we'll have your order ready.
